summary: Julong Holding Ltd filed a Form 6-K on September 29, 2026, disclosing a September 28, 2026 securities purchase agreement with named investors for a private placement of 750,000 Class A ordinary shares at US$0.300 per share and 2,250,000 pre-funded warrants at US$0.299 per warrant, each exercisable at US$0.001 for one Class A share, for gross proceeds of US$897,750 and net proceeds of approximately US$828,000. The placement relies on Section 4(a)(2) and Regulation D accredited-investor exemptions, is expected to close on or about September 29, 2026, and proceeds are earmarked for general corporate purposes. The pre-funded warrant structure avoids triggering beneficial-ownership blockers and functions as a near-equitized financing with only the nominal exercise price outstanding. This is a routine small-cap issuer capital raise, not a special situation; watch for dilution, warrant exercise pace, and any subsequent resale registration or pricing pressure from the new overhang.
